publisher: South Carolina Secretary of State through South Carolina Interactive / SC.gov
reassessment_reason: Confirm the paid corporate baseline, distinguish new-filings and UCC products, and record the September 2026 filing-login identity notice without extending it to a bulk-delivery contract.

access.bulk: Corporate baseline: monthly CSV archives CORP_NAMES.ZIP, CORP_TXN.ZIP and CORPORATION.ZIP, delivered to a subscriber FTP endpoint on the fifth. Separate new-filings product uses Corporation.xls; it is not evidence of a complete baseline.
access.api: Published web service concerns UCC filing, not a corporate registry enumeration API.
access.search: Public organization and agent search remains separate. The portal announces identity verification from September 10, 2026 for applicable online filing login; its application to bulk service is unverified.
access.fees: Corporate baseline $12,000 per fiscal year plus $125 subscription. New-filings $350/month or $3,850/year; combined UCC/corporate product $20,000/year, each with subscription charges.

fields.summary: Archive names are published, but a current field schema, stable entity-key lifecycle, status/address dictionaries and person-field inventory remain unverified. CORP_TXN cannot be assumed to supply a complete change log.

active_status_semantics: The portal defines Good Standing as legal existence not terminated or dissolved, not proof of current operation. Nonprofit good standing also does not establish solicitation authority.
statewide_completeness: The SOS filing population excludes sole proprietorships and general partnerships. Neither corporation-product scope nor all operating establishments is established by the bulk label.
address_zip: Registered-agent and registered-office information is available in public searches, but does not establish physical business locations. Bulk address/ZIP coverage is unresolved; any later projection must keep ZIP5 and ZIP4 separate.
automation_terms_fees: Registration, signature, ACH and subscriber transfer credentials are required. Push delivery is described; a supported secure-transfer, retry or replay contract remains unverified.
redistribution: General subscription terms require compliance with applicable limitations and allow additional agreements. No product-specific grant establishing derived publication or redistribution was found.
temporal_refresh: Monthly delivery is established. Baseline versus delta semantics, deletions, correction handling, checksums and control totals are unresolved; new-filings access is a distinct product.

citations.evidence: Pages 1, 2, 12-14 distinguish pricing, baseline archives, delivery and new-filings product; document footer remains version 2.7 revised 07/19/2023.
Current service page confirms bulk products require agreement and annual/monthly fees.
September 2026 filing-login identity notice and explicit Good Standing limits.
Public search provides registered-agent and registered-office information.

strongest_next_action: Keep corporate baseline contract review separate from the new-filings add-on and UCC products. Resolve current schema, entity/status/address meanings, secure delivery, change semantics, totals and derived rights before an authorized order. The new filing-login notice is not a bulk automation specification. No contact, registration, signing, payment, credentials, rows or production action is authorized.
